entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson, order 45-B-881-2. It's the GPS tracker band.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... I see the order was delivered about 30 days ago. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault. The pulse reading is complete garbage. It's off by 20 beats a minute compared to my chest strap. It's useless.

I'm very sorry to hear that it's not performing as expected. That's definitely frustrating. I have a few troubleshooting steps we could try that often resolve sensor inaccuracies, it should only take a few minutes.
Look, I don't have time for that. I'm not your technician. The product doesn't work. I just want my money back. I want a refund.
I understand your position and that you'd prefer a direct resolution. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I review our return policy against your order date.
Thank you for your patience, Mark. I've reviewed your order and our policy. You're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I cannot approve this return for a full refund for you.

I'm sending an email to the address on file right now. It will contain a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a great day.
